# f5xc_protocol_policer (Data Source)

Protocol Policer Protocol policer has set or network protocol fields and flags to be match on a layer 4 packet and corresponding rate limit to be applied, this would be useful in specifying * Ratelimiting TCP sessions accepted from in a given duration * Ratelimiting various ICMP message type packets * Ratelimiting all UDP traffic * Ratelimting DNS traffic
